v04-rain-coat.observed_description: A red-haired woman in a grey sweater stands at an open café door with rain falling outside, a long green raincoat half on: it hangs from one shoulder while both hands work behind her back, and her other shoulder is still in the sweater.
v04-rain-coat.note: Usable: the half-on coat and the rain read at 250 px. She stands right of center, so the photo stays out of four-picture cards.
